name: Answer WhatsApp sales chats with an AI agent, a Google Sheets catalog and lead capture

parameters.content:
## Answer WhatsApp sales chats with an AI agent, a Google Sheets catalog and lead capture

### How it works
1. The WhatsApp trigger receives each customer message. Repeats are skipped and voice notes are transcribed.
2. Messages sent in quick succession are grouped, so the customer gets one answer.
3. An OpenAI agent reads the chat history, searches your Google Sheets catalog and replies like a sales assistant.
4. Every reply updates the lead row in Google Sheets. Confirmed orders go to an Orders tab and to your team by email.
5. Complaints or requests for a person hand the chat to your team, who reply from a protected n8n form.
6. Quiet warm leads get one follow-up before the 24-hour WhatsApp window closes.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Add **WhatsApp OAuth** (trigger), **WhatsApp API**, **OpenAI**, **Google Sheets**, **Gmail** and **Basic Auth** credentials.
- [ ] Create Data Tables `wa_messages` (phone, message_id, direction, text, status, received_at) and `wa_contacts` (phone, name, phone_number_id, stage, mode, human_until, last_inbound_at, followup_sent), all *String*.
- [ ] Create a spreadsheet with a `Products` tab (SKU, Name, Category, Price, Stock, Description, Link) and empty `Leads`, `Orders` and `Error Log` tabs. Select it in every Google Sheets node.
- [ ] Edit **Sales Settings**, save, then activate.

### Customization
Change the selling rules in the **Sales Agent** system message.

## Receive WhatsApp messages
Drops status updates and repeated deliveries.

## Route by message type
Text goes on, voice notes get transcribed.

## Transcribe voice notes
Other media gets a polite text reply.

## Wait for message bursts
Several quick messages get one answer.

## Claim the waiting messages
Skips the AI while a person handles the chat.

## Alert staff in human mode
Forwards new messages by email.

## Load the chat history
Earlier turns from the Data Table.

## Reply with the AI agent
Searches the catalog and returns a reply plus lead data.

## Send the reply
Falls back to a safe reply if the AI fails.

## Save the conversation
Logs the reply and updates the chat state.

## Update the lead sheet
One row per customer in Google Sheets.

## Notify staff
Emails handoffs and new orders.

## Record confirmed orders
Adds the order to the Orders sheet.

## Staff replies from a form
Linked from every staff email.

## Send the staff reply
Pauses the AI or hands the chat back.

## Find chats to follow up
Warm leads quiet for 20 hours.

## Send one follow-up
Before the 24-hour window closes.

## Search the product catalog
The tool the agent calls for products.

## Catch workflow errors
Builds an incident report from any failed execution.

## Send the alert
Emails it, or logs it to the Error Log tab.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Trigger
nodes.notes: Receives customer messages from the WhatsApp Business Cloud API. "Message status updates" is empty, so sent/delivered/read callbacks never start an execution. Meta allows one webhook URL per app: use a Meta app dedicated to this workflow.

assignments.name: text

nodes.name: Read Message
nodes.notes: One message per webhook call (WhatsApp sends them one by one). Buttons and list replies are read as text.

nodes.name: Is Customer Message?
nodes.notes: Drops webhook events without a customer message (for example account or error notifications).

nodes.name: Skip Duplicates
nodes.notes: Meta re-delivers a webhook when it is not acknowledged in time. Message IDs already handled in an earlier execution are dropped here, so a customer never gets two answers.

assignments.name: business_info
assignments.value:
Opening hours: Monday–Saturday 09:00–18:00 (WIB).
Shipping: from Jakarta with JNE or J&T, 1–3 days within Java.
Payment: bank transfer or QRIS. Our admin confirms every order and sends the payment details.
Returns: within 7 days for unused items with the receipt.

assignments.name: unsupported_reply
assignments.value: Thank you! I can read text and voice messages only. Could you type your question? 🙏

assignments.name: fallback_reply
assignments.value: Sorry, I have a small technical problem. A team member will reply to you shortly 🙏

nodes.name: Sales Settings
nodes.notes: EDIT ME. business_info is the only shop knowledge besides the catalog, so keep it accurate. debounce_seconds groups messages sent in quick succession. human_pause_hours: how long the AI stays silent after a handoff. staff_reply_form_url: leave empty to use this n8n instance's form URL. Translate the two canned replies to your customers' language.

nodes.name: Route by Type
nodes.notes: Text, buttons and list replies go straight on. Voice notes are transcribed first. Images, stickers, documents and locations get a polite text reply.

nodes.name: Get Voice Note URL
nodes.notes: Media URLs from Meta are short-lived and need the access token, so the file is downloaded right away.

nodes.name: Download Voice Note
nodes.notes: Uses the WhatsApp API credential for the Authorization header.

nodes.name: Transcribe Voice Note
nodes.notes: Whisper detects the language. The transcript is stored like a typed message, prefixed with 🎤.

nodes.name: Reply · Unsupported Type
nodes.notes: Best effort: a failed courtesy reply is not worth an alert.

value.text: ={{ $('Transcribe Voice Note').isExecuted ? '🎤 ' + String($('Transcribe Voice Note').first().json.text ?? '').trim() : $('Read Message').first().json.text }}

nodes.name: Store Incoming Message
nodes.notes: Every message is stored as pending first. That is what lets several quick messages be answered together.

nodes.name: Wait for More Messages
nodes.notes: Customers often send "hi", "I want to ask" and the question as three messages. Waits stay in memory below 65 s.

nodes.name: Get Newest Pending
nodes.notes: Newest unanswered message of this customer.

nodes.name: Newest Message?
nodes.notes: False: a newer message arrived while waiting. Its own execution answers all pending messages together, so this one stops quietly.

nodes.name: Get Pending Messages
nodes.notes: All unanswered messages of this customer, oldest first.

nodes.name: Claim Messages
nodes.notes: Marks each collected message by its ID, so a message that arrives a second later is not swallowed by this batch.

nodes.name: Get Contact
nodes.notes: New customers have no row yet; Always Output Data passes an empty item instead.

nodes.name: AI Should Reply?
nodes.notes: False while a team member handles the chat (handoff), until human_until passes.

parameters.subject: =WhatsApp · {{ $('Read Message').first().json.name || '+' + $('Read Message').first().json.phone }} wrote again while you handle the chat

nodes.name: Alert Staff · New Message
nodes.notes: Only while a person handles the chat. The messages stay marked "taken" so the AI does not answer them later.

nodes.name: Get Chat History
nodes.notes: The conversation is stored in a Data Table instead of chat memory, so it survives restarts and staff replies are part of it.

assignments.name: history

nodes.name: Build Agent Input
nodes.notes: Earlier turns (customer, AI and staff) plus the new message batch. Execute Once: the history arrives as one item per row, the agent must run once.

options.systemMessage:
=You are {{ $('Sales Settings').first().json.assistant_name }}, the WhatsApp sales assistant of {{ $('Sales Settings').first().json.business_name }}. You answer customers, recommend products from the catalog and help them place an order.

Today is {{ $now.toFormat('cccc, d LLLL yyyy, HH:mm') }}.

## Language and style
- Reply in {{ $('Sales Settings').first().json.reply_language }}.
- Write like a friendly, competent shop assistant on WhatsApp: short paragraphs, at most 3 of them or a short list. No headings, no tables, no links you did not get from the catalog. Use *single asterisks* for bold and at most one emoji.
- Ask at most one question per message. Never greet again in the middle of a conversation.

## Business information (facts you may use)
{{ $('Sales Settings').first().json.business_info }}

## Products
- Call "Search Product Catalog" before you mention any product, price or stock. Never invent products, prices, discounts, stock or delivery dates.
- Recommend at most 3 products with name, price in {{ $('Sales Settings').first().json.currency }} and one reason why it fits. Say when stock is low or zero.
- If nothing fits, say so and ask one clarifying question (budget, size, use).

## Selling
- Understand the need first (use, budget, quantity, city) before pushing a product.
- When the customer wants to buy, collect product and quantity, recipient name and the full delivery address. Then repeat the order with item prices and the subtotal and ask the customer to confirm it.
- Set order.confirmed_by_customer to true only after the customer explicitly confirmed that summary. Then tell them our admin will confirm the shipping cost and payment details shortly. You never collect payments and never confirm shipping costs.

## Hand over to a person (handoff = true) when
- the customer asks for a human, admin or owner,
- there is a complaint, refund, return, damaged item, late delivery or payment problem,
- they ask for a discount, custom order or bulk deal the business information does not cover,
- the customer is upset, or you are not sure about the answer.
When you hand over, tell the customer that a team member will continue the chat. Do not promise a time.

## Output
Return JSON matching the schema, no markdown fences. "reply" is the exact WhatsApp message to send. Use "" or [] for unknown values, never omit a field.

nodes.name: Sales Agent
nodes.notes: On error the item continues with { error }: the customer gets the fallback reply and the chat goes to a person.

nodes.name: OpenAI · Sales Model
nodes.notes: Low reasoning effort keeps replies fast. Max Retries handles 429 / 5xx inside the OpenAI client.

parameters.description: Search the product catalog. Call it before you mention any product, price or stock. Returns up to 8 products (sku, name, category, price, stock, description, link), best match first, and found = 0 when nothing matches. Search again with other words before telling the customer a product does not exist.

value.query: ={{ $fromAI('query', 'Product search words: type, feature, size, colour or use. Example: "black sneakers size 42"', 'string') }}
value.max_price: ={{ $fromAI('max_price', 'Maximum unit price in the shop currency, or 0 when the customer gave no budget', 'number') }}
value.category: ={{ $fromAI('category', 'Product category if the customer named one, otherwise an empty string', 'string') }}

nodes.name: Search Product Catalog
nodes.notes: Calls this same workflow ("When Catalog Is Searched"), so the template stays one file. The workflow must be saved once before the first test.

nodes.name: Reply Schema
nodes.notes: The agent returns the reply plus structured lead, stage, handoff and order data. autoFix repairs malformed JSON once with the fixer model.

nodes.name: OpenAI · Fixer Model
nodes.notes: Only called when the agent returns JSON that does not match Reply Schema. "Use Responses API" is off on purpose: the auto-fix step reads this model's reply as plain text, and Responses API replies arrive as content blocks.

assignments.name: ok
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const o = $json.output; const ok = !!o && typeof o.reply === 'string' && o.reply.trim() !== ''; return ok; })() }}

assignments.name: reply
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const o = $json.output; const ok = !!o && typeof o.reply === 'string' && o.reply.trim() !== ''; return ok ? o.reply.trim().slice(0, 4000) : $('Sales Settings').first().json.fallback_reply; })() }}

assignments.name: handoff
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const o = $json.output; const ok = !!o && typeof o.reply === 'string' && o.reply.trim() !== ''; return ok ? o.handoff === true : true; })() }}

assignments.name: handoff_reason
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const o = $json.output; const ok = !!o && typeof o.reply === 'string' && o.reply.trim() !== ''; return ok ? (o.handoff_reason || '') : 'The AI agent failed: ' + String($json.error ?? 'no structured output').slice(0, 300); })() }}

assignments.name: stage
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const o = $json.output; const ok = !!o && typeof o.reply === 'string' && o.reply.trim() !== ''; return ok ? o.stage : $('Build Agent Input').first().json.stage; })() }}

assignments.name: lead
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const o = $json.output; const ok = !!o && typeof o.reply === 'string' && o.reply.trim() !== ''; return ok ? o.lead : {}; })() }}

assignments.name: order
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const o = $json.output; const ok = !!o && typeof o.reply === 'string' && o.reply.trim() !== ''; return ok ? o.order : {}; })() }}

assignments.name: order_ready
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const o = $json.output; const ok = !!o && typeof o.reply === 'string' && o.reply.trim() !== ''; return ok && o.order?.confirmed_by_customer === true && (o.order.items ?? []).length > 0 && String(o.order.address ?? '').trim() !== ''; })() }}

nodes.name: Finalize Reply
nodes.notes: Fail-safe: when the agent failed or returned nothing usable, the customer gets the fallback reply and the chat is handed to a person.

nodes.name: Send Reply
nodes.notes: A failure goes to the error output and raises a CRITICAL alert with the customer number: the customer got no answer. No Retry On Fail: n8n skips retries on this node type when On Error routes to an output.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ '[CRITICAL] WhatsApp refused the reply to +' + $('Read Message').first().json.phone + ' (' + ($('Read Message').first().json.name || 'unknown') + '). The customer got no answer. Their message: ' + $('Build Agent Input').first().json.new_messages.slice(0, 300) + ' | Planned reply: ' + $('Finalize Reply').first().json.reply.slice(0, 300) }}

nodes.name: Escalate · Reply Not Sent
nodes.notes: The built-in error handler emails this with the customer number, so someone can answer by hand.

nodes.name: Log Reply
nodes.notes: The sent reply becomes part of the history the agent reads next time.

nodes.name: Close Batch
nodes.notes: Answered messages leave the pending queue.

nodes.name: Save Contact
nodes.notes: Chat state per customer: sales stage, bot or human mode, and the follow-up flag (reset by every new message). Execute Once: Close Batch returns one item per closed message.

nodes.name: Build Lead Row
nodes.notes: Field names = Leads sheet headers. Cell format RAW stores the phone number as text, so it keeps its digits.

nodes.name: Upsert Lead
nodes.notes: One row per customer, updated after every reply. Headers are created on an empty tab.

nodes.name: Only Confirmed Orders
nodes.notes: Passes only when the customer confirmed the order summary in this turn.

nodes.name: Build Order Row
nodes.notes: Field names = Orders sheet headers. The Order ID is derived from the execution, so the staff email shows the same ID.

nodes.name: Save Order
nodes.notes: Your team confirms shipping cost and payment, then updates Status.

nodes.name: Notify Staff?
nodes.notes: Handoffs and confirmed orders need a person.

parameters.subject: ={{ $('Finalize Reply').first().json.order_ready ? '[New order] ' : '[Handoff] ' }}{{ $('Save Contact').first().json.name || '+' + $('Read Message').first().json.phone }} on WhatsApp

nodes.name: Email Staff
nodes.notes: Contains the order, the handoff reason, the latest messages and a link to the staff reply form with the phone number filled in.

parameters.formDescription: Sends your message from the business WhatsApp number. WhatsApp only delivers it within 24 hours of the customer’s last message.

values.fieldLabel: Customer phone (country code + number, digits only)

values.option: Keep the AI paused for 12 hours
Keep the AI paused for 24 hours
Hand the chat back to the AI

nodes.name: Staff Reply Form
nodes.notes: Protected with Basic Auth: anyone with access could message your customers. The staff emails link here with ?phone= filled in.

nodes.name: Find Customer
nodes.notes: Only customers who wrote to you before can get a reply (WhatsApp rule).

nodes.name: Send Staff Reply
nodes.notes: Error output: usually the 24-hour customer service window has closed.

nodes.name: Log Staff Reply
nodes.notes: Staff replies are part of the history, so the AI knows what was promised when it takes over again.

value.human_until: ={{ (() => { const a = $('Staff Reply Form').first().json.after; if (a.startsWith('Hand')) return ''; return $now.plus({ hours: a.includes('24') ? 24 : 12 }).toISO(); })() }}

nodes.name: Update Chat Mode
nodes.notes: Pauses the AI for 12 or 24 hours, or hands the chat back right away.

parameters.completionMessage: ={{ 'Your message was delivered to WhatsApp. ' + ($('Staff Reply Form').first().json.after.startsWith('Hand') ? 'The AI assistant answers this customer again.' : 'The AI assistant stays paused for this customer.') }}
WhatsApp refused the message. Free-form replies are only allowed within 24 hours of the customer’s last message. Ask the customer to write again, or use an approved template.
This number has not written to your WhatsApp number yet. Check the country code (for example 62 for Indonesia) and the digits.

nodes.name: Every Hour
nodes.notes: Runs only while the workflow is active.

assignments.name: followup_text
assignments.value: Hi {name} 👋 just checking in. Do you still need help choosing? Reply here and I will help you right away.

nodes.name: Follow-up Settings
nodes.notes: EDIT ME. WhatsApp allows free-form messages only within 24 hours of the customer’s last message, so keep followup_after_hours below 23. {name} is replaced with the customer’s name.

nodes.name: Get Follow-up Candidates
nodes.notes: Contacts in AI mode that have not had a follow-up since their last message.

nodes.name: Due for Follow-up?
nodes.notes: Warm leads that went quiet for followup_after_hours, while the 24-hour window is still open.

nodes.name: Send Follow-up
nodes.notes: One follow-up per silence. A failure is skipped: the window may just have closed.

nodes.name: Mark Follow-up Sent
nodes.notes: Set even when sending failed, so a closed window is not retried every hour.

nodes.name: Log Follow-up
nodes.notes: Logged with an empty text when sending failed, so it never shows up in the AI history.

nodes.name: When Catalog Is Searched
nodes.notes: Entry point of the "Search Product Catalog" tool. Runs as a separate, short execution per search.

nodes.name: Read Product Catalog
nodes.notes: Columns: SKU, Name, Category, Price, Stock, Description, Link. Edit the sheet any time; the next search sees the change.

nodes.name: Rank Products
nodes.notes: Plain keyword scoring: name 3, category 2, description 1 point per word, out-of-stock last, price capped by max_price. Swap in a vector store for very large catalogs.

nodes.name: On Workflow Error
nodes.notes: Internal error workflow: n8n starts here when any production execution of THIS workflow fails (and Settings → Error workflow is empty).

nodes.name: Alert Settings
nodes.notes: EDIT ME. Who gets incident alerts. Comma-separate multiple emails.

assignments.name: severity
error_message
assignments.value: ={{ String($('On Workflow Error').first().json.execution?.error?.message ?? $('On Workflow Error').first().json.trigger?.error?.message ?? 'No error message provided').slice(0, 2000) }}

nodes.name: Build Incident Report
nodes.notes: Normalises the Error Trigger payload (execution errors and trigger errors have different shapes) into one incident record.

parameters.subject: =[{{ $json.severity }}] n8n · {{ $json.workflow_name }} failed at "{{ $json.failed_node }}"
parameters.message:
=

{{ $json.severity }} · {{ $json.workflow_name }}

Incident {{ $json.incident_id }} · {{ $json.occurred_at }}

Failed node{{ $json.failed_node }}
Error{{ $json.error_message }}
Details{{ $json.error_description || '—' }}
Execution{{ $json.execution_url ? 'Open failed execution #' + $json.execution_id + '' : $json.execution_id }}
Workflow{{ $json.editor_url ? 'Open in editor' : $json.workflow_id }}
Mode{{ $json.mode }}{{ $json.is_retry ? ' (retry)' : '' }}

Next step: open the failed execution, check the input of the failed node, fix the cause, then use Retry → From failed node in the Executions list.

nodes.name: Email Alert
nodes.notes: Primary alert. Email is independent of the services this workflow calls, so their outage cannot silence the alert. Retries 3× / 5 s, then the fallback runs.

nodes.name: Error Log Row
nodes.notes: Shapes the Error Log columns and renames the email failure reason. Keeps a field called 'error' away from the Sheets node: Retry On Fail treats an output item with 'error' as a failed try and would append the row again.

nodes.name: Fallback · Log to Error Sheet
nodes.notes: Only runs when the email alert failed after 3 tries. Appends the incident to the 'Error Log' tab; the header row is created on first use. If this fails too, the error run shows as failed in Executions.
